 MAMAMOO Seoul Encore Concert — Global K-Pop Group Announces 2027 Finale
 Nov 5, 2026 1:09 AM PST [Photo] OSEN DB. 
 Girl group MAMAMOO is set to continue their complete-group synergy by holding an encore concert in Seoul, fueled by the enthusiastic support of fans worldwide.
 MAMAMOO (Solar, Moonbyul, Wheein, Hwasa) will hold their encore concert ‘MAMAMOO 2026 WORLD TOUR ‘4WARD’ FINALE in SEOUL’ (hereafter ‘4WARD’) for two days on January 2–3, 2027, at the Ticketlink Live Arena in Seoul Olympic Park.
 ‘4WARD’ combines the number ‘4’, symbolizing the four members, with ‘FORWARD’, meaning progress. It conveys the message that the members, who have solidified their positions as solo artists in their respective fields, are reuniting to write a new chapter together.
 Following the launch of their world tour ‘4WARD’ in Seoul last June, MAMAMOO has been carrying out a grand journey spanning 18 cities worldwide. They have cemented their global influence as ‘trustworthy vocal powerhouses’ across Asia—including Kaohsiung, Macau, Singapore, Manila, Hong Kong, Kuala Lumpur, and Tokyo—as well as North American cities like New York, Chicago, and Los Angeles.
 In particular, major Asian cities such as Seoul, Kaohsiung, Macau, Hong Kong, Tokyo, and Taipei recorded sold-out shows for all seats, proving their immense popularity. Having demonstrated overwhelming complete-group synergy through their world tour, MAMAMOO plans to bring a spectacular grand finale to their long journey with this Seoul encore concert.
 Meanwhile, MAMAMOO’s encore concert ‘4WARD’ will take place on January 2–3, 2027, at the Ticketlink Live Arena in Seoul Olympic Park, following their upcoming stop in Taipei on November 28–29 as part of their world tour.
